references.text: Also deals with those who entice others to serve foreign gods, with instructions to investigate the matter thoroughly and punish the guilty
The preceding context warns against prophets or dreamers who attempt to lead the people away to other gods
Warns against turning aside from the Lord's commands to follow other gods
Warns against letting sinners entice you, a theme that reflects the temptation from close relatives in Deuteronomy
Concerns the one who leads their neighbor astray and guides them on a path that is not good
Prophesies that a man's enemies will be his own household members, reflecting the theme of close relationships that can lead people away from God
Jesus quotes Micah and teaches that loyalty to him must take precedence even over the closest family ties
Jesus teaches that whoever does not hate their father and mother, wife and children for his sake cannot be his disciple
Paul warns against those who preach a different gospel, even if it should be an angel from heaven or close coworkers
